findings.title: traceID log attribute silently dropped
findings.body: The old logRequest implementation added a 'traceID' attribute (via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) to each log entry. The rewritten logRequest no longer includes traceID, and the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go also doesn't add it. This means plugin request completion logs will no longer be correlatable with trace IDs, a regression in observability that isn't mentioned in the PR description.

findings.title: instrumentContext() duplicated logic now only sets context, not logger message formatting consistency
findings.body: instrumentContext builds contextual attributes using log.WithContextualAttributes, but these attributes are only retrievable through FromContext() calls. Since TestLogger.FromContext (pkg/plugins/log/fake.go) just returns a brand-new empty TestLogger discarding any contextual attributes, any test relying on verifying that contextual attributes (pluginId, dsName, uname, etc.) are correctly logged cannot be validated with the current fake implementation, and no test was added for ContextualLoggerMiddleware or for verifying FromContext() produces the expected attributes end-to-end.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards call context, breaking tests of contextual logging
findings.body: FromContext on TestLogger always returns a fresh NewTestLogger() instance that has no connection to the original TestLogger's recorded calls or the context's attributes. Since LoggerMiddleware now calls m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...) instead of m.logger.Info(...), any test using TestLogger to assert on logged messages/attributes via LoggerMiddleware will not observe anything recorded on the original TestLogger instance, since the Info call happens on the discarded instance. This silently breaks the ability to unit test LoggerMiddleware's logging behavior with TestLogger, and no updated test was included for logger_middleware.go despite the significant behavior change (contextual attributes, dropped pluginId/endpoint/dsName/uname/traceID in logParams).

findings.title: Removed structured log fields (pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID, uname) from logParams without equivalent verification
findings.body: logRequest previously added pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID directly into logParams. These are now expected to come via the contextual logger set by ContextualLoggerMiddleware/instrumentContext, but there's no test verifying that the final emitted log record actually contains these fields through the FromContext()-based logger chain. If the contextual-logger wiring order ever changes (e.g., LoggerMiddleware placed before ContextualLoggerMiddleware), these fields would be silently lost from logs with no test coverage to catch such a regression.
